description: This bar chart illustrates the performance, measured in percentage (%), of three language models – Llama3, Qwen2, and ChatGPT – across three knowledge domains: Songs, Basketball, and general knowledge. The horizontal axis displays the knowledge domains, labeled “Songs”, “Basketball”, and with no label for the third category, and is categorical with no defined order. The vertical axis, labeled “Ratio (%)”, represents a linear scale ranging from 60 to 100, with tick marks at intervals of 10. Three sets of bars are present, one for each knowledge domain, with each set containing three bars representing the performance of each language model. Within each set, the bars are arranged in the order of Llama3 (blue), Qwen2 (red), and ChatGPT (yellow). For the “Songs” domain, Llama3 reaches approximately 93%, Qwen2 reaches approximately 63%, and ChatGPT reaches approximately 82%. In the “Basketball” domain, Llama3 reaches approximately 88%, Qwen2 reaches approximately 85%, and ChatGPT reaches approximately 78%. For the unlabeled domain, Llama3 reaches approximately 96%, Qwen2 reaches approximately 98%, and ChatGPT reaches approximately 82%. No bars are visually emphasized through shading, bolding, outlining, or annotation.
